subject.title: test(release): harden shared UI and performance proof

question: Should this release-prep PR remain test-only by mirroring the current filtered chat settings adapter, or expand to change production persistence of lastActiveSessionKey?
rationale: The helper attempts to persist the active session, but changing the production adapter would add runtime behavior outside the PR's stated test-only scope.

options.title: Keep test-only scope
options.body: Mirror the production adapter in the fixture and leave any active-session persistence change for a separate reviewed item.

options.title: Fix production persistence
options.body: Expand the PR to pass lastActiveSessionKey through the production adapter and add focused runtime regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep test-only scope
recommendation.body: Mirror the production adapter in the fixture and leave any active-session persistence change for a separate reviewed item.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the route-owned Control UI host and settings boundary introduced by this architecture work.
